title: Pan-Seared Fish with Charred Skillet Portuguese Flakes
description: A delicious and flavorful dish with pan-seared fish, crispy charred skillet flakes, and a hint of Portuguese spices.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets (4)
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well, such as cod or tilapia

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the charred skillet Portuguese flakes and stir to combine.
Place the fish fillets in the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the fish hot with a squeeze of lemon and a side of the charred skillet flakes.
